justification: Vote 1 (read aloud as a native). Read title, passage, four prompts, sixteen options and four rationales aloud, and read each of the twenty-one fleet-repair-1 spans with two sentences on either side. Every round-1 prescription landed and none left a wound. ”saltat smör i tunnor” now agrees with the paragraph-4 sentence that had contradicted it (”Smöret saltades hårt och packades i tunnor”); ”ju längre bort från byn en fäbod låg” fronts the distance phrase and keeps correct subordinate-clause order (adverbial, then subject, then finite verb); ”helst med en gammal ko i spetsen” reads as one act instead of two and still leaves ”Kalvarna följer henne av sig själva” its antecedent; ”lätt att fastna för” now matches the formality around it; ”samma vecka som den är klar” restores the relative. The spans rewritten wholesale for other gates also hold on the ear: ”Järnvägsbyggena, gruvorna och städerna betalade bättre än sex kronor och ett par skor” picks up the exact figure planted in paragraph 3, and ”På de vallar som ännu betas går korna uppför samma stig” is a clean hinge with no stranded pronoun. I stopped at three places and cleared all three. ”på Trindbodarna har stugan och fyra bodar fått nytt tak” is distributive singular over a counted plural subject, which Swedish licenses and which cannot be misread here because five buildings cannot share one roof. ”avståndet betydde litet” is the older adverbial neuter, correct and in register for facktext; my round-1 note on it carried no conviction and still carries none, and it is not the ”säger lite om” defect, which understates rather than measures. ”en given innebörd” in the rebuilt q2 key is the Swedish ”förutbestämd” of ”vid en given signal”, not an English ”a given meaning”. No finding.

Vote 2 (systematic grammar sweep: en/ett, definiteness, BIFF, verb forms, pronoun and predicative gender agreement, prepositions, compound joints, collocations, non-words). Cleared with zero findings. GENDER AGREEMENT, the class that produced round 1's kill and the class this unit's own repair agent caught three more of in its draft: every pronoun and predicative in the student-facing layer was traced to its antecedent. The kill is fixed (”B är försiktigt formulerat … men det gör lönen till en ersättning”), and the newly written text introduced none: ”C lyfter fram textens vändpunkt och gör den till ämnet” (vändpunkt, en), ”C är riktigt i sitt första led” (alternativ, ett), ”Sådana uppköpare ville ha färsk mjölk, och de ville ha den varje dag” (mjölk, en), ”de går den utan att drivas” (stig, en), ”Kalvarna följer henne” (ko), ”desto torrare gjordes de” (ostarna), ”Fäbodens idé hade varit den motsatta” (idé, en), ”messmör, brunt och sötaktigt” (ett), ”mjölkboden … höll sig sval” (en), ”spannmål från utlandet billig” (spannmål is utrum), ”har stugan och fyra bodar fått nytt tak” (tak, ett). BIFF: every subordinator plus finite verb plus negation checked; ”när ingen längre ville ta tjänst”, ”En besättning som inte har gjort vandringen”, ”att två kvinnor på samma vall därför inte lockade lika”, ”eftersom hornet också användes” are all correct, and no negation is stranded after a subordinate finite verb anywhere in the unit. Indirect-question ”som” correct in all four q1 options: obligatory after the subject wh in A, C and D, absent where the wh is adverbial in B. The rewritten q4 rationale avoids the coordinated-att-clause predicative trap by taking a verb (”står i textens andra stycke”), not a predicative. Compound joints, all established: klövjehäst, klövjesadel, byastämma, buföring, mikaelitiden, räkenskapsbok, lövsprickning, handelsgödsel, vallodling, järnvägsbygge, kvällsdimma, betesdjur, hemäng, inägor, utmark, fäbodbruk, augustivärme, tjänsteår, mansålder, björksly. No coinage of the lönbok / tilläggsvinst / hylltid class. No English lemma inflected as Swedish. Collocations checked against the shipped list: ”lägga turer över lägena”, ”ta tjänst”, ”föll ur bruk”, ”utgå i varor”, ”isen släppte”, ”skilja ljuden åt”, ”binda X till Y” all native; no ”dämma ut”, no ”dika om”, no ”lägga ut ett skäl”, no ”datera mot”. ”skämde”-class typos absent. ”skrämde bort rovdjuren” in the rebuilt q2 C uses a generic definite plural with no prior mention, which Swedish permits and which the fäbod setting supports; recorded as examined, not as a finding. No finding.

Vote 3 (register and genre). Declared genre is facktext and the passage holds it end to end: a result-lede, ethnological-historical vocabulary, a named scholar whose own methodological objection is reported in his voice (”Svagheten pekar han själv ut”), a present-tense coda. fleet-repair-1 changed five spans for G-REGISTER reasons and none broke the voice. ”i tre angränsande socknar” is the same survey-scope register as before. ”Järnvägsbyggena, gruvorna och städerna” names the documented pull on rural labour and, as the repair log notes, leaves the passage with no real proper noun at all, which is if anything more in genre for a textbook chapter about a generic parish. Deleting ”Något finns kvar.” and opening paragraph 8 on the count itself removes a summarising editorial beat and the paragraph is drier for it. ”På de vallar som ännu betas” replaces a two-clause survival flourish with a plain condition. Swept explicitly for this lane's shipped register defects and found none: no English metaword anywhere (all four rationales open ”Rätt svar X:”), no snake_case label, no internal rule or law reference, no rule self-attestation, no constructor's-bench framing (no ”uppsättningen” for the option set, no ”textförfattaren” for the author, and the word ”alternativ” does not appear in this unit's rationales at all), no reader address, no blog or chat register, no anglicism, no serial comma. Typography uniform: en dashes only, no em dash, no straight quotes, no ellipsis character. The rationale layer is one formal register throughout, with the round-1 spoken-register leak (”lätt att gå på”) removed. No finding.

findings: ”Alla som vill stå måste söka varje år, men den som stod på torget året innan får stå där igen” -> ”Alla som vill ha plats måste söka varje år, men den som stod på torget året innan får stå där igen” (passage ¶5, the clause fleet-repair-1 added; MINOR, REPAIR-INTRODUCED. The added clause lands three more forms of stå/står directly after ”kastanjerna står där de står”, giving five in two consecutive sentences; the ear hears the pile-up before the arithmetic the clause exists to license.)

”tre av ståndsraderna” -> ”tre av raderna på fältet” (passage, coda; MINOR, REPAIR-INTRODUCED. ”ståndsrad” is a coined compound and its -s- joint is the one Swedish uses for stånd meaning social estate – ståndssamhälle, ståndsmässig, ståndsperson – not for stånd meaning market stall. If the compound is kept, the native joint is ”ståndraderna”.)
justification: Vote 1 (read aloud as a native). The passage is still the strongest Swedish of the three LÄS units: a real insändare voice, numbers spelled out, the conditional inversion, the plain idiom of ”går ihop” and ”står i vägen”, a coda that stops without a moral. All five round-1 prescriptions landed and all five improved the read: ”lägger fram ett skäl” is the right particle, ”lämnar ingenting åt slumpen” restores the fixed idiom, the comma after the fronted conditional (”och flyttar marknaden ut, tjänar jag på det”) is there, ”skribenten” has replaced ”textförfattaren” in both the prompt and the key rationale, and the duplicated ”låter självklar / låter därför självklart” is gone. Two of the repair's own new spans are what stop the ear now, and both are new. The added ¶5 clause is necessary – it is what makes the seventy-four ALL applicants rather than only the new ones, which is what the key's subtraction needs – but it was dropped into the one sentence position where ”stå” was already ringing, and ”Alla som vill stå … får stå där igen” directly after ”kastanjerna står där de står” is four stå-forms in about twenty words. The coda's ”ståndsraderna” snags for a different reason: round 1 asked only that ”raderna” be given an antecedent, and the repair supplied one by coining a word rather than by naming the field. I re-examined ”Fyrtiotre av de femtioåtta stånden på torget sköts av en enda människa” for the one-person-runs-forty-three misreading and cleared it: ”en enda” is the distributive intensifier, and Swedish reserves ”en och samma” for the reading that would be absurd here.

findings: ”tre av ståndsraderna” -> ”tre av raderna på fältet” (passage, coda; MINOR, REPAIR-INTRODUCED, unestablished-compound class. ”ståndsrad” is attested nowhere; the -s- fogemorfem attaches to stånd in its social-estate sense (ståndssamhälle, ståndsmässig), so the joint points away from the market stall the sentence means. Alternative if the compound is wanted: ”ståndraderna”.)
justification: Vote 2 (systematic grammar sweep). Cleared with zero findings: BIFF over every subordinator plus finite verb plus negation, including ”något som inte stod på lappen”, ”Ingen som räknar kommer fram till något annat”, ”att hon inte tänker påstå”, ”Att hon inte kan bemöta invändningen”, ”som texten aldrig räknar samman”. En/ett and adjective agreement throughout (”Det andra skälet är hårdare”, ”ingen ny handel utan en avgift till”, ”ett bihang”, ”igenspikad dörr”). PRONOUN AND PREDICATIVE GENDER, the class this lane keeps failing: every one traced, and the repair introduced no slip – ”fyran hämtas ur texten, men den hör till lediga platser” (fyra, en), ”Plats 1 var ingen av dem: den står i Gottfrid Runessons namn” (plats, en, and ”ingen” correctly in the en-form), ”övertogs de av andra” (four places, plural – the round-1 fix), ”jag tycker inte att det håller” (skäl, ett), ”formuleringen är den försiktigaste av alternativen” (formulering, en), ”ett dämpat påstående” (ett). Verb forms: ”sköts” is the present passive of sköta and not of skjuta; ”lär enligt henne ingen någonting” is a subject-initial main clause with the sentence adverbial in its correct post-finite slot, not an inversion error. Definiteness, including the elliptical genitive ”ritas efter förra årets”. Prepositions and collocations native: ”flytta ut den på fältet”, ”ha någon bakom sig”, ”gå ihop”, ”stå i vägen”, ”på tvären”, ”stå i någons namn”, ”räcka till”, plus the two round-1 repairs ”lägga fram ett skäl” and ”lämna åt slumpen”. Compound joints all established except one: höstmarknad, torghandlare, brandgata, platskarta, lastplats, frukträd, bärbuskar, äppelträd, våghus, provår are all real; ”ståndsraderna” is the single coinage and is the finding. No English lemma inflected as Swedish, no non-word, and no omitted relative ”som” creating a second parse.

findings: ”A (en regel som låter självklar men inte står där):” / ”B (siffran stämmer, sakförhållandet inte):” / ”C (företrädet åt fel håll):” -> ”A: lottning är det vanliga när fler vill in än det finns rum för, men regeln står inte i texten.” / ”B: siffran stämmer, men inte sakförhållandet.” / ”C: företrädet ligger åt fel håll.” (q1 rationale; MINOR, PRE-EXISTING not repair-introduced. The bracketed label names the trap from the item-writer's side and drops the rationale out of running prose; recast as sentences it says the same thing in the register the other two LÄS units keep.)

”B (halva kravet):” / ”C (medgivandet läst som slutsats):” / ”D (provåret som texten säger nej till):” -> ”B tar halva kravet.” / ”C läser medgivandet som slutsats.” / ”D är det provår texten säger nej till.” (q2 rationale; same device, same MINOR.)
justification: Vote 3 (register and genre). The passage is authentic insändare Swedish and holds one voice: first person with a declared interest, the concession stated before the demand, the single-sentence imperative paragraph as the pivot, a byline with a stall number. The repair did not damage it. The added ¶5 clause is in the same flat declarative register as its neighbours; ”runt fältet” fixes a genuine third name for the same ground and is a register gain; ”ståndsraderna” is a lexical problem, not a register one, and votes 1 and 2 have it. The named lane defect is gone from the student-facing layer: ”textförfattaren” is now ”skribenten” in both the q2 prompt and the key rationale, which also removes the clash with the ”skribenten” already used for the same person in the C and D paragraphs, and ”i uppsättningen” for the option set is now ”av alternativen”. Swept for the rest of the shipped list and found none: no English metaword (both rationales open ”Rätt svar X:”), no snake_case, no rule or law reference, no rule self-attestation, no anglicism, no translationese, no blog or chat register, no reader address. Typography clean: en dashes only, no straight quotes. What remains is the one place where the rationale layer speaks from the bench rather than to the student: six bracketed trap-labels, three per question, each naming the mechanism of a distractor as a construction category. They are Swedish and a student can read them, which is why this is a flag and not a kill, and they are pre-existing rather than repair-introduced; but they are the only rationale prose in the three LÄS units that is not running prose, and ”siffran stämmer, sakförhållandet inte” in particular is a marking-key formulation rather than an explanation to a reader.

findings: ”Ingen har tagit ut kopparna, och ingen har sagt att de ska stå där.” -> ”Ingen har tagit ut kopparna ur det, och ingen har sagt att de ska stå där.” (passage ¶7, the coda; MINOR-to-MAJOR, REPAIR-INTRODUCED. fleet-repair-1 deleted ”Kopparna står kvar i det.”, which was doing two jobs: it named what the cups would be taken OUT OF, and it was the antecedent that licensed ”där”. Without it, ”tagit ut” has no stated source, and the nearest ”där” – ”fick stå i hallen, där det är för stort”, one clause earlier – points at the hall, so two ”där” in consecutive sentences take different referents.)
justification: Vote 1 (read aloud as a native). The essay voice is intact and all eight round-1 prescriptions landed: ”avgjordes inte av hur nära man stod varandra, utan av vad besöket gällde” has the right verb and a matching correlative preposition; ”utrymme att avvara” is the verb for sparing space; ”den läsning allmänbildningen inbjuder till” replaces the ”locka till” that wanted a reaction; ”Teven” has replaced ”Televisionen” in both the passage and the q2 prompt, so the passage's later ”apparaten” now has a matching first mention; the ”för” / ”för att” coordination is repaired; and the whole clause containing ”daterar mot varandra” is gone with the option it described. The one place the read now breaks is the coda, and it is the repair's own doing: removing ”Kopparna står kvar i det.” for a G-REGISTER reason took out the sentence the next one was leaning on. Read aloud, ”Ingen har tagit ut kopparna” arrives with nothing to be taken out of, and ”de ska stå där” lands on the hall, which is where the previous ”där” just put us. The essay's point survives – nobody decided anything – but a native ear registers the gap. I re-read the other repaired spans and cleared them: ”Man brukar peka på värmen och lägenheterna. Det stämmer så till vida att …” correctly switches the pronoun to neuter now that there is no ”Den förklaring” to agree with; ”Vilka togs, enligt texten, emot i det stängda rummet?” puts the parenthetical in the slot Swedish reserves for sentence adverbials, between the finite verb and its particle (”han togs inte emot”), which is the shape the unit's own q2 stem already had; and ”Tyngst öppnades rummet vid dödsfall” is licensed comparative fronting that ranks the occasions, not a manner claim about opening.

findings: ”Ingen har tagit ut kopparna, och ingen har sagt att de ska stå där.” -> ”Ingen har tagit ut kopparna ur det, och ingen har sagt att de ska stå där.” (passage ¶7; MINOR-to-MAJOR, REPAIR-INTRODUCED. Two faults from one deletion: ”ta ut” is left without its source complement, and the deictic ”där” is left without an antecedent of its own while an adjacent competing one, ”i hallen”, is live. ”ur det” resolves to ”Glasskåpet” in the immediately preceding sentence and restores both.)
justification: Vote 2 (systematic grammar sweep). Cleared with zero findings: BIFF, checked over every subordinator plus finite verb plus negation (”att rum som ingen bodde i”, ”koppar som aldrig hann bli smutsiga”, ”att det inte var närheten … som avgjorde”, ”att den inte gjorde det”, ”ett steg som texten inte tar”). En/ett and adjective agreement throughout, including the two the repair wrote: ”Rummet stod orört sedan apparaten burits ut” has neuter ”orört” against ”rum”, and ”Det stämmer så till vida” is neuter against a propositional antecedent where the pre-repair ”Den” had agreed with a now-deleted ”förklaring”. PRONOUN GENDER, the class this fleet keeps breaking, traced exhaustively in the rewritten layer: ”men slutet av stycke 5 motsäger den” (slutsatsen, en), ”men texten säger uttryckligen att den inte gjorde det” (närheten, en), ”Mot den står två ting i texten” (läsningen, en), ”stod den i tre vintrar … framför den” (teven, en), ”Glasskåpet … där det är för stort” (ett). Not one slip. Verb forms correct, including the supine after ”sedan” with the auxiliary dropped (”sedan apparaten burits ut”). The three omitted relative ”som” are all licit object relatives with a single parse (”andra jag har frågat”, ”de ärenden det var till för”, and the repair's ”skälet Hilding ger”); none gives a clause two readings. Compound joints all established: skogsbygd, soffgrupp, glasskåp, distriktssköterska, köksbord, farstu, bygdegård, ytterrock, hedersrum, möbelbyte, tidsuppfattning, ytterdörr, dödsfall – no coinage of the lönbok class, and nothing like las-b21-002's ”ståndsrad”. No English lemma inflected as Swedish, no non-word. Collocations native throughout: ”släppas in”, ”visas in”, ”bli stående”, ”hållas stängd”, ”peka på”, ”så till vida att”, ”lämna i fred”, ”spänna över decennier”, ”hålla någon högt”, ”gå igen” of a door; the round-1 ”datera mot varandra” does not occur anywhere in the file. The single finding is a reference and valency fault rather than a morphological one, and it is the repair's.

Vote 3 (register and genre). Declared genre is essä and the passage is one: a first-person memory essay with a controlling image (the door you walk past), an interview source quoted in genuinely spoken Swedish, an explicit refusal to resolve the causal question (”Vad som kom först vet varken jag eller Hilding”), and a coda that withholds its own conclusion. fleet-repair-1 touched register in two places and both are gains. Replacing ”Den förklaring man brukar få är värmen och lägenheterna” with ”Man brukar peka på värmen och lägenheterna” removes a received-explanation template that the repair log documents as recurring across three units and two languages, and the move it introduces – grant the account, then demote it – is unchanged. Dropping the survival predicate from the coda leaves the essay resting on the non-decision alone, which is more in genre, and the remaining instance in ¶5 is load-bearing for q2/B. The cost of that second edit is a reference break, which is votes 1 and 2's finding and is not a register fault. Swept for the lane's shipped register defects and found none: no English metaword (both rationales open ”Rätt svar X:”), no snake_case label, no rule or law reference, no rule self-attestation, no constructor's-bench vocabulary – ”uppsättningen” for the option set does not occur, ”textförfattare” does not occur, and the author is never named as a role in the prompts. No blog or chat register, no anglicism, no translationese; the only colloquial diction sits inside the quotation marks (”Sen bar far ut den i köket”) where it belongs, and ”i stan” in the coda is standard written Swedish, not a lapse. Typography clean: Swedish double quotes correctly paired, one en dash for the byline, no em dash, no straight quotes. The q1 stem's new referring expression ”det stängda rummet” is plain descriptive Swedish and reads as a stem, not as a paraphrase machine. No finding.
